About The Song
"Midnight Sun" is a song by Swedish singer Zara Larsson from her fifth studio album of the same name (2025). It was released as the album's second single on 13 June 2025 through Sommer House and Epic Records. At the 68th Annual Grammy Awards, the song was nominated for Best Dance Pop Recording, becoming Larsson's first Grammy nomination. A remix version of the song featuring American singer Muni Long was released on 14 November 2025.
